title: Blackpool Restaurant
body: A ninety-foot, clear-span, square, steel framed, mixed serviced restaurant with its own kitchen and stores due to its isolated location. Timber-clad and lined throughout with ply and steel mirrors, this is a cosy cigar-box of a building through whose tinted windows only those seated can watch the Zoo’s residents. (C.P. in The Square Book, p. 81)
subtitle: Cedric Price architects
